predicate.label: confers authority on institution
predicate.definition: Legal instrument or governing document X explicitly grants authority, powers, rights, or an institutional mandate to Y.
includes: an identified power or authority granted to Y
explicit rights or mandate conferred under X
excludes: ordinary transfer of physical goods or sporting contribution
mentioning institutional requirements without granting authority
general association with a legal text
ambiguous: give or grant with omitted object
under-X have with no identified power
a provision whose grant or recipient is unresolved
predicate.notes: This labels what the supplied text asserts, not a legal determination. Generic gives does not recover an omitted legal power.
predicate.scope_notes: Includes: an identified power or authority granted to Y; explicit rights or mandate conferred under X; historical textual allocation of authority. Excludes: ordinary transfer of physical goods or sporting contribution; mentioning institutional requirements without granting authority; general association with a legal text. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: give or grant with omitted object; under-X have with no identified power; a provision whose grant or recipient is unresolved. This labels what the supplied text asserts, not a legal determination. Generic gives does not recover an omitted legal power.

rationale: Constitution→Senate/Congress grant/provision/give family dominates. The instrument must actually confer a specified right or power; omitted giving object is ambiguous. Athletic contribution is separate.
